content.json:
## HoneyLabs Threat Intelligence

Indicators from internet-facing honeypot sensors. Every one is **evidence-backed**: the IP ran an exploit or loader command against a sensor, or the URL was pulled out of a payload those commands fetched. Known research scanners are excluded and indicators expire as activity stops.

`Confidence` grades the evidence behind each indicator (90 = 100+ observed attacks, 60 = a single sighting), so you can pick an alerting threshold instead of muting the feed. Labels carry the source network (`asn:ASxxxx`), origin (`country:XX`) and the indicator kind.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = dcount(Id), LastReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Status = iff(isempty(LastReceived), 'No HoneyLabs indicators yet: check the TAXII connector', 'Connected')
| project Status, Indicators, LastReceived
content.title: Connection

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = dcount(Id) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Indicators received over time

content.json:
### Choosing an alerting threshold

Higher confidence means more observed attacks behind the indicator. A practical start is to alert on the top band and watchlist the rest, then widen once you see the real volume in your environment.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = count() by Confidence
| extend Evidence = case(Confidence >= 90, '100+ observed attacks', Confidence >= 80, '10-99 observed attacks', Confidence >= 70, '3-9 observed attacks', '1-2 observed attacks')
| project Confidence, Evidence, Indicators
| sort by Confidence desc
content.title: Active indicators by confidence

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| extend Kind = case(ObservableKey == 'url:value', 'Malware loader/C2 URL', ObservableKey == 'ipv4-addr:value', 'Exploiter source IP', 'Other')
| summarize Indicators = count() by Kind
content.title: What the feed contains

content.json:
### Where the attacks come from

Concentration by network is what makes a blocking decision defensible: a handful of ASNs usually carry a disproportionate share of the traffic.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| mv-expand Label = Data.labels to typeof(string)
| where Label startswith 'asn:'
| extend ASN = replace_string(Label, 'asn:', '')
| summarize Indicators = count() by ASN
| top 15 by Indicators desc
content.title: Top source networks

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| mv-expand Label = Data.labels to typeof(string)
| where Label startswith 'country:'
| extend Country = replace_string(Label, 'country:', '')
| summarize Indicators = count() by Country
| top 15 by Indicators desc
content.title: Top origin countries

content.json:
### Which CVEs are being probed in the wild

Available on paid HoneyLabs plans. Each of these indicators is a source IP that went after a specific CVE's exploit path against a sensor, labelled with the CVE ids it targeted. Unlike a vendor severity score this is an observed, in-the-wild signal, so it is a practical input to patch prioritisation: cross-reference the top rows against what you actually run and expose.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| mv-expand Label = Data.labels to typeof(string)
| where Label startswith 'cve-'
| extend CVE = toupper(tostring(Label))
| summarize ProbingSources = dcount(Id), Evidence = max(Confidence) by CVE
| top 20 by ProbingSources desc
content.title: Most-probed CVEs by number of distinct source IPs

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| where Data.labels has 'cve-probing'
| summarize ProbingSources = dcount(Id) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: CVE-probing sources over time

content.json:
### Matches in your environment

Where these indicators line up with your own traffic. An empty panel here is good news. Matches are ordered by confidence so the best-evidenced hits surface first.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| where ObservableKey == 'ipv4-addr:value'
| extend TI_ip = tostring(ObservableValue)
| join kind=innerunique (CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP)
    | extend CS_ip = SourceIP) on $left.TI_ip == $right.CS_ip
| summarize Matches = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Matches against CommonSecurityLog

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| where ObservableKey == 'ipv4-addr:value'
| extend TI_ip = tostring(ObservableValue)
| join kind=innerunique (CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP)
    | extend CS_ip = SourceIP) on $left.TI_ip == $right.CS_ip
| summarize Events = count(), Hosts = dcount(DeviceName), Blocked = countif(DeviceAction has_any ('block', 'deny', 'drop')), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by TI_ip, Confidence
| extend Report = strcat('https://honeylabs.net/lookup/', TI_ip)
| sort by Confidence desc, Events desc
| take 50
content.title: Matched indicators (highest evidence first)

content.json: Each row links to its full HoneyLabs report: first seen, the exact requests, payloads and CVEs probed. Data from [HoneyLabs](https://honeylabs.net).
